clips.hook: Every influencer says these coins are dead. We are at a 130X.
clips.caption:
People are talking a lot of smack about the coins that came out in 2024 and 2025. Toshi and Peanut and Pengu, and you name it: they are not going to pump. But we did this 94x on Tutorial on BNB just last September, and look where it is. We are officially at a 130x.

Look at this thing, man. Freaking 94x, holy crap. What if Toshi is going to pump? What if Pengu is going to pump? What if all these others are going to pump? And look at Velvet. Velvet is pumping too, and that is my 58x-er from just two months ago. The open interest is really up, and people are shorting like crazy and getting liquidated.

What if the meme coins from last year can still pump? Every single influencer is spreading FUD about them. So if you are spreading FUD about Toshi: what is going to replace Toshi? Toshi is the face of Base. What meme coin is going to replace Toshi now?

Drop your answer in the comments.

clips.hook: I estimated a 20X. It did a 353X in a bear market.
clips.caption:
It is absolutely insane, man. It just goes back to how I underestimate things. I estimated a 20x on LAB, and we did a 353x. I estimated like a 30x on Velvet, and we did a 58x. We did a 94x on Tutorial, and I did not think it was going to make a comeback. After the October 10th crash it gave the impression that it was just dead. It did not recover at all, it just kept going down. And then look what happened.

So it makes me think: should I be more of a moon boy? Because I am seeing the good plays and I am playing them. Obviously I have all these amazing plays. It is insane amounts of good plays. I am calling these pumps.

And the biggest disparity of them all: I am probably going to get a 20x off of LAB, and it ends up going to 353x. In a freaking bear market nonetheless. Holy crap. Jeez.

Which call did you underestimate the most? Comment below.

clips.hook: The Robinhood CEO has a real Shiba Inu. That dog is now a coin.
clips.caption:
Somebody commented on my video: this is the Shiba of Robinhood. And it is a real dog. Vlad, the CEO of Robinhood, actually has a Shiba Inu, adopted during the Doge era. He got the dog because he was into memes. You know how bullish that is, man? I cannot wait for us to get into this bull run. It is going to be like the most exciting times ever.

Is he going to be inclined to put this on the Robinhood app, for Robinhood retail to come in and buy it? I mean, it could be.

And look at the precedent. Kishu Inu just went parabolic in the bull run of 2021. It went to two billion without any centralized exchanges. And the name sounds the same. Very good chart. I would not mind buying into this right now.

Would you ape a coin named after the CEO's actual dog? Let me know in the comments.

clips.hook: I sold my excavator to buy more Kaspa. And yes, Kaspa is going down.
clips.caption:
A huge hurricane hit my town, and I lost like 100 trees on my property. Why would I pay another crew 20,000 dollars to clean it out when I can just buy an excavator and do it myself? So I got an excavator. And when the work was done, I went and sold my excavator so I can buy more Kaspa.

And yeah, Kaspa has been really weak. Whenever Bitcoin goes down, Kaspa goes down. When Bitcoin goes back up, Kaspa stays down. Then Bitcoin goes down again, and Kaspa goes down some more. It is nuts.

But I think the pain is going to be relieved soon enough. Even if it takes another year, all this pain is going to be worth it in the long run.

I am battle-hardened. I am ready for some more pain. I do not care.

Kaspa holders: how are you holding up? Comment below.
